answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 8713 Country: India Title: is writing or maintianing personal dairy prohibited in islam? Question: is writing or maintianing personal dairy prohibited in islam? Answer ID: 8713 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 2139/1673=H/1429) By ?personal diary? perhaps you mean writing personal accounts, then there is no wrong to write and maintain it, but it should be free from lying, exaggeration and other similar evils. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
